topics.note: 自监督表征两边都有（word2vec/BERT），但图神经网络两边都没有章节，故组合项整体 partial。；原D2L负责自监督表征；补充中文DGL讲解图上消息传递、多层GraphSAGE和节点训练，二者组合覆盖图网络与自监督表征，不声称DGL单独覆盖全部自监督方法。；D2L already covers word embeddings and BERT self-supervision; Hamilton supplies GNN architecture and practice, closing the graph-network half.

steps.read: 按 4→6→7→8→9→10→14 章顺序读并跑 notebook，重点手写 self-attention 与一个 BERT 预训练小例子。
在D2L架构和预训练之后，依次读DGL第2章、第3章（含3.2 forward）、5.1；运行两层GraphSAGE节点分类，检查邻域聚合怎样改变表示。
Read chapters 5–11 and 15–16, implementing MLP, a ResNet block, an LSTM and a Transformer block; do the pretraining chapter's word2vec/BERT exercises.
Read GRL Ch5–6 after D2L architectures and self-supervised pretraining; implement one aggregation layer and compare supervised and link-prediction objectives.
